selection.holdout_scope: whole galaxy; prediction remains conditional on a scaling calibrated outside target velocities
selection.selection_conditioning: quality, coverage and baryonic-mass predictor are selection criteria; the target curve outcome was not scored
selection.independence_caveat: No joint covariance is supplied for shared distances, inclination/geometry, HI flux calibration, or HI mass versus HI kinematics. A single held-out galaxy cannot independently establish the K-Mb exponent.

products.license_and_citation: IRSA data-use terms say most public-hosted products have no use restrictions; cite S4G papers and DOI 10.26131/IRSA425. Exact terms: https://irsa.ipac.caltech.edu/data_use_terms.html ; DOI: https://doi.org/10.26131/IRSA425
products.map_mass_caveats: Requires a declared 3.6 micron stellar M/L and vertical profile. P5 analysis ellipse is not full RC support; outer stellar tail needs a predeclared continuation or bracket.

products.product: NGC4559-HR_coldens.fits (1024x1024 H I column-density map; 4-arcsec pixels; FITS beam 28.379x13.104 arcsec)
products.fits_header_unit_warning: BUNIT says JY/BEAM.km/s, but HISTORY records a conversion from moment-0 Jy/beam km/s to N_HI using 1.823e18*606*1e3/(28.37887*13.10430); use HISTORY and validate the released column-density convention before modeling.
products.version_note: Version 2 corrects NGC4448 cubes and moment-1 products only; NGC4559 products are unchanged from version 1.
products.required_citation: Heald et al. (2011), HALOGAS-DR1; include the record acknowledgement.

products.release: Public final survey products; no numbered release version identified
products.license: No separate product license identified on the official data page; cite Walter et al. 2008 and THINGS data release.

candidate_comparison.name: NGC4559
candidate_comparison.selection_assessment: Primary: strongest joint data quality and geometry, with approximately factor-two mass contrast. The P5 aperture covers only about 12 kpc; extension to the outer curve is unresolved source modeling.

candidate_comparison.name: NGC7793
candidate_comparison.selection_assessment: Fallback: strong independent mass leverage and verified THINGS map access, but the SPARC inclination uncertainty is much larger and P5 quality is acceptable rather than excellent.

scaling_contract.conditional_derivation: Assume comparable dimensionless TG response in homologous source/branch/boundary families so K*Vflat^2 is common, and a common flat-regime baryonic Tully-Fisher law Vflat^4=A*Mb. Then K proportional to (A*Mb)^-1/2.
required_preregistered_choices: exponent fixed at -1/2 before target curve access
common baryonic mass, distance and helium conventions
uncertainty on M/L, BTFR normalization, geometry and K calibration
flat-curve applicability, source-profile homology and physical exterior boundary
scaling_contract.one_train_galaxy_limitation: NGC3198 can calibrate a declared normalization, not validate the exponent; one target tests only one conditional prediction.
